mapper.select: SELECT homeworkid, teacherid, reviewers_per AS reviewersPer, max_score AS maxScore, anonymous, status, create_time AS createTime FROM peer_review_task WHERE homeworkid = #{homeworkid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO peer_review_task (homeworkid, teacherid, reviewers_per, max_score, anonymous, status, create_time) VALUES (#{homeworkid}, #{teacherid}, #{reviewersPer}, #{maxScore}, #{anonymous}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE teacherid = #{teacherid}, reviewers_per = #{reviewersPer}, max_score = #{maxScore}, anonymous = #{anonymous}, status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE peer_review_task SET status = #{status} WHERE homeworkid = #{homeworkid}
mapper.select: SELECT sh.id AS submitid, sh.studentid AS studentid, s.studentname AS studentname, sh.content AS content, sh.filepath AS filepath, sh.status AS status FROM studenthomework sh LEFT JOIN student s ON s.studentid = sh.studentid WHERE sh.homeworkid = #{homeworkid} AND sh.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY sh.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO peer_review (homeworkid, reviewerid, submitid, revieweeid, status, assign_time) VALUES (#{homeworkid}, #{reviewerid}, #{submitid}, #{revieweeid}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT pr.id AS id, pr.homeworkid AS homeworkid, pr.submitid AS submitid, pr.status AS status, pr.score AS score, pr.comment AS comment, pr.submit_time AS submitTime, h.title AS homeworktitle, c.coursename AS coursename, t.max_score AS maxScore, t.anonymous AS anonymous, t.status AS taskStatus FROM peer_review pr LEFT JOIN homework h ON h.homeworkid = pr.homeworkid LEFT JOIN course c ON c.courseid = h.courseid LEFT JOIN peer_review_task t ON t.homeworkid = pr.homeworkid WHERE pr.reviewerid = #{reviewerid} AND pr.status = #{status} ORDER BY pr.status ASC, pr.id DESC

SELECT pr.id AS id, pr.homeworkid AS homeworkid, pr.reviewerid AS reviewerid, pr.submitid AS submitid, pr.revieweeid AS revieweeid, pr.status AS status, pr.score AS score, pr.comment AS comment, sh.content AS content, sh.filepath AS filepath, s.studentname AS revieweename, h.title AS homeworktitle, h.type AS homeworktype, h.content AS homeworkcontent, c.coursename AS coursename, t.max_score AS maxScore, t.anonymous AS anonymous, t.status AS taskStatus FROM peer_review pr LEFT JOIN studenthomework sh ON sh.id = pr.submitid LEFT JOIN student s ON s.studentid = pr.revieweeid LEFT JOIN homework h ON h.homeworkid = pr.homeworkid LEFT JOIN course c ON c.courseid = h.courseid LEFT JOIN peer_review_task t ON t.homeworkid = pr.homeworkid WHERE pr.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE peer_review SET score = #{score}, comment = #{comment}, status = 1, submit_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND reviewerid = #{reviewerid} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT pr.id AS id, pr.homeworkid AS homeworkid, pr.score AS score, pr.comment AS comment, pr.submit_time AS submitTime, h.title AS homeworktitle, c.coursename AS coursename, t.max_score AS maxScore, t.anonymous AS anonymous, CASE WHEN t.anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE rs.studentname END AS reviewername FROM peer_review pr LEFT JOIN homework h ON h.homeworkid = pr.homeworkid LEFT JOIN course c ON c.courseid = h.courseid LEFT JOIN peer_review_task t ON t.homeworkid = pr.homeworkid LEFT JOIN student rs ON rs.studentid = pr.reviewerid WHERE pr.revieweeid = #{revieweeid} AND pr.status = 1 ORDER BY pr.submit_time DESC

SELECT pr.revieweeid AS revieweeid, s.studentname AS studentname, s.studentno AS studentno, COUNT(pr.id) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviewedCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pr.status = 1 THEN pr.score END), 1) AS avgScore FROM peer_review pr LEFT JOIN student s ON s.studentid = pr.revieweeid WHERE pr.homeworkid = #{homeworkid} GROUP BY pr.revieweeid, s.studentname, s.studentno ORDER BY avgScore DESC
SELECT COUNT(id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done FROM peer_review WHERE homeworkid = #{homeworkid}
